files.caption: Three photographs of 1517 Taylor Street, Middletown, Ohio. Photographs are dated December 1, 1949. The real estate listing for 1517 Taylor Street reads: An outstanding pretty white house with 3 lots surrounded by a white fence. Has 2-story home with large living room, fireplace, dining room and kitchen. Two large bedrooms, nursery and bath on second floor. Basement with warm air furnace. On the rear of the lot there is a garage with overhead door and workshop. Everything in good condition. Deta
